title: ProQR to Present Clinical and Preclinical Progress from AX-0810 and AX-0811 at Upcoming Conferences
summary: ProQR is a clinical stage biotech company based in the Netherlands that discovers and develops unique RNA-based therapies for severe genetic disorders.
body_markdown:
- ProQR to present its ADAR-mediated RNA editing approach and progress toward next-generation editing oligonucleotides at TIDES Europe plenary session
- AX-0810 Phase 1 data to be featured in two poster presentations at AASLD, The Liver Meeting® 2026, including one late-breaking poster
- Cohort 3 data and the 12 week follow up from the AX-0810 Phase 1 study along with new preclinical proof-of-concept data for AX-0811 to be presented at Nature Conferences RNA at the Bench and Bedside V in December 2026
- Next-generation AX-0811, an NTCP-targeting RNA editing oligonucleotide generated using ProQR’s AI-enabled discovery engine is being evaluated in a Phase 1 study in healthy volunteers, with initial data expected in early January 2027


LEIDEN, Netherlands & CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ProQR Therapeutics N.V. (Nasdaq: PRQR) (ProQR), a clinical-stage company dedicated to changing lives through transformative RNA therapies based on its proprietary ADAR-mediated Axiomer™ RNA editing technology platform, today announced upcoming presentations highlighting clinical and preclinical progress with AX-0810 and AX-0811 and the broader Axiomer RNA editing platform at TIDES Europe, The Liver Meeting 2026, Nature Conferences RNA at the Bench and Bedside V.


**Upcoming Presentations**


**TIDES Europe 2026**


Gerard Platenburg, ProQR’s chief scientific officer, will deliver a plenary presentation reviewing previously presented clinical findings from AX-0810, including a favorable safety and tolerability profile and NTCP target engagement that demonstrate successful translation. The presentation will also highlight AI-enabled advances in the discovery of AX-0811, a next-generation Axiomer RNA editing oligonucleotide with preclinical data demonstrating greater potency and durability, underscoring the potential of ProQR’s Axiomer platform.


**Plenary session title:** “Clinical Validation of ADAR RNA editing and translation to AI-driven next-generation EONs”
**Presenter:** Gerard Platenburg, Chief Scientific Officer
**Date and time:** November 3, 2026, 16:25 CET
**Location:** Amsterdam, Netherlands


**AASLD The Liver Meeting** **®** **2026**


The AX-0810 Phase 1 study will be featured in two poster presentations at The Liver Meeting® 2026, the annual meeting of the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases (AASLD), taking place November 5–9, 2026. The presentations will focus on study design, as well as previously disclosed safety, pharmacokinetic, and target engagement findings from the study.


**Poster presentation**
**Title:** Safety, pharmacokinetics and target engagement of AX-0810 a first-in-class RNA editing therapy designed to modulate bile acid transport for cholestatic disease
**Abstract number:** 1156
**Presenter:** R. Bart Takkenberg, MD, PhD, Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Amsterdam University Medical Center, Amsterdam
**Date and time:** November 5, 2026, 12:00pm-1:00pm MT
**Location:** Denver, CO


**Late-breaking poster presentation**
**Title:** First-in-person evidence of in vivo Axiomer RNA Editing of NTCP for the treatment of cholestasis: Proof of concept data from the AX-0810 Phase 1 Trial
**Late-breaking abstract number:** 5032
**Date and time:** November 8, 2026, 1:00pm-2:00pm MT
**Location:** Denver, CO


**Nature Conferences RNA at the Bench and Bedside V**


Cohort 3 data and the 12 week follow up from the AX-0810 Phase 1 study and new preclinical proof-of-concept data for AX-0811 will be presented at Nature’s RNA at the Bench and Bedside V in December 2026.


**Presentation title:** From clinical validation to next-generation ADAR RNA editing: Advancing NTCP modulation with AX-0810 and AX-0811 for cholestatic disease
**Presenter:** Gerard Platenburg, Chief Scientific Officer
**Date and time:** December 9, 2026, 2:30-3:00pm PT
**Location:** La Jolla, California


Building on the clinical experience with AX-0810 and encouraging preclinical proof-of-concept findings, AX-0811, a next-generation NTCP-targeting RNA editing oligonucleotide designed with improved potency and durability is being evaluated in a Phase 1 study in healthy volunteers with initial data expected in early January 2027.


The presentations and posters will be made available on the Publications and Presentations section of ProQR’s website following their presentation, subject to applicable conference policies.


**About Axiomer** **™**


ProQR is pioneering a next-generation RNA base editing technology called Axiomer™, which could potentially yield a new class of medicines for diverse types of diseases. Axiomer™ “Editing Oligonucleotides”, or EONs, mediate single nucleotide changes to RNA in a highly specific and targeted way using molecular machinery that is present in human cells called ADAR (Adenosine Deaminase Acting on RNA). Axiomer™ EONs are designed to recruit and direct endogenously expressed ADARs to change an Adenosine (A) to an Inosine (I) in the RNA – an Inosine is translated as a Guanosine (G) – correcting an RNA with a disease-causing mutation back to a normal (wild type) RNA, modulating protein expression, or altering a protein so that it will have a new function that helps prevent or treat disease.


**About ProQR**


ProQR Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company dedicated to changing lives through the creation of transformative RNA therapies. ProQR is pioneering a next-generation RNA technology called Axiomer™, which uses a cell’s own editing machinery called ADAR to make specific single nucleotide edits in RNA to reverse a mutation or modulate protein expression and could potentially yield a new class of medicines for both rare and prevalent diseases with unmet need. Based on our unique proprietary RNA repair platform technologies we are growing our pipeline with patients and loved ones in mind.
